caption: The highlighted cells A0 to A4 spell count; forward has crossed the sentinel at A5 and now sits on = in B0, which cannot extend the identifier, so count is accepted. Each $ is a sentinel marking the end of a half-buffer and is never part of the input.

spec.title: count=1+2; with N = 5 per half
spec.aria: Two half-buffers of five characters plus a sentinel; the identifier count occupies cells 0 to 4 of Buffer A with lexemeBegin on cell 0, and forward has crossed the sentinel at cell 5 of Buffer A and now points to cell 0 of Buffer B, holding the equals sign that ends the identifier.
